Description: The business provides psycho-educational evaluations to students and schools. The evaluations are conducted at the student's school/home or through tele-assessment. The purpose of the evaluation is to determine if the student may benefit from specialized services at school, testing accommodations etc. The evaluations are conducted by a licensed educational psychologist and consist of cognitive testing and observations at the student's school and in the student's home. Meetings with school staff and parents to provide the results of the evaluation generally take place at the student's school or virtually.
